key.name: enable-minimize
key.description: Allow a four-finger swipe down to minimize the focused window.

key.name: enable-restore
key.description: Allow a four-finger swipe up to restore the most recently minimized window.

key.name: diagonal-strictness
key.description: 0 = Relaxed (ratio 1.0), 1 = Balanced (ratio 2.0), 2 = Strict (ratio 3.0). Higher values require a straighter vertical swipe.

key.name: focus-restored-window
key.description: Explicitly focus a window after restoring it. Off by default, which leaves focus handling to Mutter.

key.name: show-osd
key.description: Show an on-screen icon when a gesture performs or skips an action.

key.name: action-threshold
key.description: Distance in unaccelerated touchpad units a four-finger vertical swipe must travel before the configured action runs.
